description: This file defines a ProgressController class and related functions for managing progress, timeouts, and abort signals within the Playwright core server. It handles progress tracking, logging, and timeout management for asynchronous tasks.

classes.name: ProgressController
classes.description: Manages progress, timeouts, and abort signals for asynchronous operations, providing logging and timeout handling.

methods.name: createForSdkObject
methods.description: Creates a ProgressController instance for a specific SDK object with logging.

methods.name: runInternalTask
methods.description: Runs an internal task with progress management and optional timeout.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts ongoing progress with an error.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a task with progress tracking, timeout, and abort handling.
